title: Host-Side Bidirectional RPC Transport
description: The ToolProcess manages a tool subprocess with reader threads for buffered bidirectional communication.
body: The host side of transport A: spawn a tool binary, speak the codec on its stdin/stdout, and hand back a handle callers use like a synchronous RPC client even though two background threads are doing the actual I/O. `pending` is the hinge everything turns on: `call_timeout` inserts a sender keyed by request id before writing the request, and the reader thread below removes and fires that sender when the matching response (or, on EOF, a synthetic failure) shows up.
